versions.changelog:
- Skill name changed from "pixwith-media-generation" to "pixwith-ai"
- Installation/setup guidance is now shown as a bulleted list for clarity
- No functional changes or workflow adjustments introduced
- All core instructions, workflows, and guardrails remain unchanged

- Initial release of Pixwith Media Generation skill for OpenClaw.
- Supports AI video and image generation across 40+ models, including Sora, Veo 3, Kling, Seedance, GPT Image, Hailuo, and WAN.
- Provides workflows for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video generation.
- Integrated guidance for configuration and MCP setup, including ready-to-use examples.
- Includes guardrails for model discovery, schema inspection, credit checking, and robust error handling.
